title: Typography Do’s
slide_intent: Match type treatment to the tone and length of a message so a reader hears the intended emphasis.
strategic_value: Flexible case and weight choices can keep T-Mobile confident in short claims and approachable in personal stories.
demonstration: Four applications compare all-caps emphasis, heavier sentence case, lighter narrative text and contrasting text over an image.
practical_value: Choose all caps for short attention cues or sentence case for a more conversational reading rhythm.
